title: specht report
description: The document specht writes for --json and --report (0001-F3). Within a tool major version it changes only by addition (C-4).

schemaVersion.description: The schema version the tree was checked against, as major.minor.patch.

schemaSource.description: Where the schemas the check used came from: the set embedded in the tool, the repository's own files, or the on-disk copy of a recorded upstream source.

layouts.description: Each layout, with how many specifications were discovered in it.

layout.description: The layout's name in the manifest; the default manifest names epics, epics/**/spec.md, and features, **/.spec/README.md.

itemCount.description: How many task, test, bug and spike files sit beside the specifications.

rulesEvaluated.description: How many SPEC### rule ids were evaluated.

violations.description: Every violation, errors first, then by file, line and rule id.

file.description: Relative to the root the tool was given, with / separators; never absolute.

line.description: One-based line, or 0 when the file as a whole is at fault.

identifier.description: The identifier at fault; absent when the rule has none.

expected.description: What the rule expected, as named members per rule family. Open: a rule family adds members, never removes or renames one (C-2, C-4).
